description: Impact report for proposed NetworkPolicy changes. baseline contains verdicts for all queries under current policies. changes contains the impact analysis for each proposed modification.

baseline.description: Baseline verdict for each connectivity query under the current policy set

changes.description: Impact analysis for each proposed NetworkPolicy change

classification.description: SAFE: no impact on required/forbidden. BREAKS_REQUIRED: a required connection becomes DENIED. OPENS_FORBIDDEN: a forbidden connection becomes ALLOWED. CRITICAL: both breaks required AND opens forbidden.

newly_allowed.description: Query IDs that flip from DENIED to ALLOWED under this change

newly_denied.description: Query IDs that flip from ALLOWED to DENIED under this change
